configurationFields.label: Server Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the full URL to download the server from. [Login](https://foundryvtt.com/) to obtain a current timed URL, then update the server before the timeout. NOTE: Make sure to select the "Node.js" version

configurationFields.label: Server Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the version of the server that is installed, which determines the appropriate application to run

configurationFields.label: Node.js Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets the Node.js release stream from which to install the latest version, unless a specific version is specified under Node.js Version. Use v22 for server version 13, v24 for server version 14. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Node.js Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Node.js version](https://nodejs.org/download/release/) to install. Format: v22.22.2. Empty = latest version for the release stream specified under Node.js Release Stream. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Node.js Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Sets any Node.js command line arguments to include as startup parameters

configurationFields.label: Enable UPnP
configurationFields.description: If set, UPnP will be enabled on the server. This functionality requires a UPnP-enabled router to work

deploymentSteps.name: Node.js Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $NodeVersion='{NODEVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path 'foundry-vtt'; if (Test-Path 'node/node.exe') { $InstalledVersion =  & node/node.exe --version } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($NodeVersion) ) { $NodeVersion = 'v' + ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://endoflife.date/api/v1/products/nodejs/releases/{NODERELEASE}\").result.latest.name) }; if ( $NodeVersion -notmatch '^v(18|20|22|24)\.\d+\.\d+$' ) { Write-Output 'Invalid Node.js version format specified'; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $NodeVersion ) { Write-Output \"Node.js $NodeVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path node.zip ) { Remove-Item node.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://nodejs.org/download/release/$NodeVersion/node-$NodeVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile node.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Node.js CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"node.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path node.zip ) { Remove-Item node.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"node-*\") { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like \"node-*\" } | Rename-Item -NewName \"node\" *> $null; Write-Output \"Node.js $NodeVersion downloaded\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: Check Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd server && if [[ ! -f {APP} ]]; then echo \"You must specify the Node.js version (not Linux version) of the Foundry VTT server for GSCS to install under Server Download URL in GSCS's settings, and select the Server Version accordingly. Aborting\" && exit 1; else exit 0; fi"

deploymentSteps.name: Check Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'server'; if (!(Test-Path '{APP}')) { Write-Host \"You must specify the Node.js version (not Windows version) of the Foundry VTT server for GSCS to install under Server Download URL in GSCS's settings, and select the Server Version accordingly. Aborting\"; exit 1 } else { exit 0 }"
